Rahul Gandhi faces backlash over mimicry incident at event

A controversy has erupted after a comedian, Pulkit Mani, mimicked Prime Prime Minister Narendra Modi on stage during an event attended by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi. The incident occurred in Indore. Following the backlash, Pulkit Mani cancelled his upcoming show in Noida. Former BJP MP Brijbhushan Sharan Singh criticized Rahul Gandhi over the incident, stating that mothers should not be a subject of politics and calling the act "extremely shameful."
